# Lab 16.4: Advanced Conversational Analytics

## What We Are Going to Do
Ask the agent for forecasts, anomalies and root causes, use Python analysis, and chat with a graph and a Lakehouse table.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Forecast.** In a conversation with `thelook_sales_agent` ask: *"Forecast daily revenue for the next 30 days."* The agent uses `AI.FORECAST`. Open the SQL to confirm.

2. **[Console] Anomalies.** *"Were there any unusual days in revenue in the last 90 days?"* The agent uses `AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES`.

3. **[Console] Root cause.** *"Revenue in the last month changed compared with the month before. What drove the change?"* The agent uses `AI.KEY_DRIVERS` across category, country and traffic source.

4. **[Console] Python analysis.** *"Calculate the correlation between product retail price and return rate and show a scatter plot."* The agent writes and runs Python with the code interpreter. Expand the code to read it.

5. **[Console] Graph source.** Add `lab15.FinGraph` as a source in a new conversation and ask *"Which accounts send money to a blocked account?"*

6. **[Console] Lakehouse source.** Add `lab10.orders_iceberg` and ask *"How many archived orders are there per month?"*

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Forecasts | `AI.FORECAST` behind the answer |
| Anomalies | `AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES` |
| Root cause | `AI.KEY_DRIVERS` |
| Sources | Tables, graphs and Iceberg tables |
